title: Workflow SDK now writes over WebSockets on Vercel
summary_en: The Workflow SDK now sends event writes and stream writes to Vercel Workflows over a WebSocket by default, replacing one HTTP request per write, or per write group for streams. No code change is needed beyond upgrading to workflow@5.2.0 or later. Once you deploy the upgrade, new runs use it. In-flight runs finish on the deployment they started on. Existing streaming code works as is.
